description: Check a game or kit folder on this machine against the core loop rule every GripForge game follows (docs/game-engine-contract.md §12): game logic only on the game tick (game.engine tick.hz set explicitly), frame/present hooks and physics callbacks read only, the GripForge tick stepped from the frame callback and never from _physics_process / FixedUpdate, the engine physics step not retuned, no tick path waiting on another thread, and the render/physics Workers and shared memory not turned off without a stated reason. Rules: tick_missing, frame_mutates_state, physics_runs_gameplay, engine_physics_retuned, worker_disabled, shared_memory_disabled, physics_main_thread, sync_worker_call. Each problem comes with its file, line and fix. ok=false fails the game or kit; same check as gripforge game-check --loop (CLI), refused by gripforge kit build. Free, local, reads only.

path.description: Absolute path of the game folder (web export, Godot, Unity or Unreal project) or of a kit folder.

name: gripforge_core_loop_check
title: Check the core loop rule of a local game or kit
